strings.vendor.guide_note: This card does not read or change driver settings; the steps are applied by hand in the vendor menu. Change one setting at a time and compare before/after in the same game scene.
strings.vendor.nvidia.title: NVIDIA
strings.vendor.nvidia.sysmem: CUDA - Sysmem Fallback Policy: change the default only if you see stutter/crashes from VRAM overflow, then compare in the same scene; the policy is not read by the app.
strings.vendor.nvidia.clean_install: If a driver change causes problems: download the driver first, clean with DDU in safe mode, reboot and install. DDU is not needed for every version.
strings.vendor.nvidia.overlay: Enable the NVIDIA App/GeForce Experience overlay only during measurement; an always-on overlay can add frame-time cost. The app does not measure that cost.
strings.vendor.amd.title: AMD
strings.vendor.amd.profiles: Adrenalin > Gaming > Global Graphics and a per-game profile can differ; the game profile overrides global. Check both before measuring; the app cannot read the profile without ADLX.
strings.vendor.amd.hypr: HYPR-RX enables RSR, Radeon Boost and Anti-Lag together; HYPR-RX Eco lowers power draw. Disable it during in-game FSR/DLSS or baseline measurement and compare in the same scene.
strings.vendor.amd.ris: Radeon Image Sharpening sharpens the image at low render scale; do not stack it with DLSS/FSR sharpening; excessive values cause halos/ringing.
strings.vendor.amd.channel: Prefer the Adrenalin Recommended/WHQL channel; install Optional only when it carries a specific fix. If stutter persists after an update, reset the shader cache (Adrenalin > Settings).
strings.risk.launch.insecure: -insecure disables VAC protection and joins untrusted servers. Do not use it in competitive play.
strings.risk.launch.third_party: -allow_third_party_software relaxes CS2 Trusted Mode; third-party software/overlay risk increases.
strings.risk.launch.high_priority: -high forces the game process to high priority; it can contend with background processes and cause stutter.
strings.risk.launch.threads: -threads pins the thread count manually; it can break core selection on hybrid CPUs.
strings.risk.launch.resolution_override: -w/-h overrides the in-game resolution; it can conflict with the monitor's native resolution.
strings.risk.video.vsync: In-game V-Sync is on: it adds input latency. Turn it off when using variable refresh.
strings.risk.video.borderless: Borderless window mode: DWM composition can add latency; compare with fullscreen.
strings.risk.video.reflex_off: NVIDIA Reflex/AMD Anti-Lag appears off; enable it if supported.
strings.risk.video.msaa: MSAA above 4x: high shader cost; lower it if you cannot hold your FPS target.
strings.risk.process.realtime: The game process runs at Realtime priority: system, disk and driver threads can starve; stutter and audio dropouts may occur. Use Normal or Above Normal.
strings.risk.process.high: The game process runs at High priority: it can contend with background and driver work; it does not help on every system.
strings.risk.process.affinity_fixed: The game process CPU affinity is manually narrowed: fewer cores are used and 1% low FPS can suffer. Return to the default all-core mask.

strings.guide.title: Competitive game settings: general rules
strings.guide.res: Run the game at the monitor's native resolution and highest supported refresh rate (Game Readiness checks this).
strings.guide.latency: Turn on NVIDIA Reflex or AMD Anti-Lag if the game has it; "On + Boost" mostly helps only when CPU-limited.
strings.guide.sync: On a G-Sync/FreeSync display, cap FPS a few frames below the refresh rate (e.g. 141 for 144 Hz). Without variable refresh, keep in-game V-Sync off.
strings.guide.window: Fullscreen or borderless: in DirectX 10/11 games the latency gap shrinks with "Optimizations for windowed games" on.
strings.guide.quality: Turn off motion blur, film grain and depth of field; shadow, reflection and volumetric quality cost the most FPS.
strings.guide.shader: Do not clear the shader cache: the game recompiles on first launch and stutters.
strings.guide.source: Sources: vendor documentation and independent tests (November 2026). Every game and system differs; verify changes with the App Test or the game's own measurement. Ecu Fps does not write game settings files.
strings.bench.mode_quick_note: Each component is measured under full load for about 10 seconds after a short warm-up.
strings.bench.mode_full_note: Components run at full load for longer; heat build-up and throttling become visible. The PC will warm up and fans will speed up.

strings.plan.power_cpu: Processor power settings: boost on, core parking off
strings.plan.power_cpu.desc: Changes only the AC (plugged-in) values of the active power plan: the performance boost mode is switched to Enabled only when it is set to an Efficient mode, and core parking is turned off. Heat and power draw may rise; battery (DC) values are unchanged. Requires administrator permission (UAC).
strings.plan.power_cpu.desc.svc: Changes only the AC (plugged-in) values of the active power plan: the performance boost mode is switched to Enabled only when it is set to an Efficient mode, and core parking is turned off. Heat and power draw may rise; battery (DC) values are unchanged. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt.
strings.plan.power_pcie.desc: Turns off PCIe link state power saving on AC only in the active power plan; may reduce transition stutter on some systems, no difference on others. Battery (DC) values are unchanged. Requires administrator permission (UAC).
strings.plan.power_pcie.desc.svc: Turns off PCIe link state power saving on AC only in the active power plan; may reduce transition stutter on some systems, no difference on others. Battery (DC) values are unchanged. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt.
strings.plan.hags.desc: The graphics card manages its own work queue; on some systems latency and stutters drop, on others there is no difference. Requires administrator permission (UAC) and takes effect after a restart. Only offered when graphics card and driver support is confirmed; you can measure it with an A/B test.
strings.plan.hags.desc.svc: The graphics card manages its own work queue; on some systems latency and stutters drop, on others there is no difference. Needs administrator rights (the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt) and takes effect after a restart. Only offered when graphics card and driver support is confirmed; you can measure it with an A/B test.
strings.plan.nvidia: NVIDIA driver settings: maximum performance, low latency
strings.plan.nvidia.desc: In the NVIDIA global profile, power management is set to "Prefer maximum performance" and the prepared-frame queue is limited to one (same effect as Low Latency Mode "On"). The queue limit only affects DirectX 9/11 games; in DirectX 12/Vulkan the game manages its own queue. In-game Reflex takes precedence when present. The effect is mostly on latency and stutter; idle power use may rise. Requires administrator permission (UAC).
strings.plan.nvidia.desc.svc: In the NVIDIA global profile, power management is set to "Prefer maximum performance" and the prepared-frame queue is limited to one (same effect as Low Latency Mode "On"). The queue limit only affects DirectX 9/11 games; in DirectX 12/Vulkan the game manages its own queue. In-game Reflex takes precedence when present. The effect is mostly on latency and stutter; idle power use may rise. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt.
strings.plan.services: Stop selected background services for the session
strings.plan.services.desc: The Windows services you mark on the Startup page are stopped while Performance is on and started again when it is turned off. Their startup type does not change. Requires administrator permission (UAC); each service is re-checked right before it is stopped.
strings.plan.services.desc.svc: The Windows services you mark on the Startup page are stopped while Performance is on and started again when it is turned off. Their startup type does not change. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt. Each service is re-checked right before it is stopped.
strings.plan.restore_point: Create a Windows restore point first
strings.plan.restore_point.desc: Before the administrator changes, Windows is asked for a system restore point (it may take up to a minute). Windows skips it if one was made recently, and it is never turned on if System Protection is off. Turning Performance off does not delete restore points; your settings are restored from the app's own record.
strings.plan.update_hold.desc: Windows Update is not turned off; automatic download becomes a notification, and forced restarts while you are signed in are blocked. On Windows Home the notify setting may have no effect. Off restores it. Nothing is changed if an organization policy exists. Asks for administrator permission (UAC).
strings.plan.update_off.desc: Warning: automatic updates are turned off; security updates will not arrive on their own until you turn Performance off. May have no effect on Windows Home. Off restores the previous values. Asks for administrator permission (UAC).
strings.tweak.update.no_reboot: Forced restart while signed in → off
strings.tweak.update.do_off: Delivery Optimization → this PC only (no sharing to other PCs)
strings.plan.privacy.desc: Advertising ID, personalised suggestions and silent app installs are turned off for this user; no administrator permission needed. No FPS effect is expected. Off restores the previous values.
strings.plan.privacy_system: Privacy: diagnostic data and activity history (system)
strings.plan.privacy_system.desc: Diagnostic data is set to the Required level (0 only works on Enterprise/Education, so it is not written; an existing policy value is left alone) and activity history publishing is turned off. No FPS effect is expected. Off restores the previous values. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.tweak.privacy.tailored: Personalised tips from diagnostic data → off
strings.plan.background: Lower background programs to low priority (nothing is closed)
strings.plan.background.desc: The listed background programs are only moved to low CPU priority and power saving; none is closed or has its data touched. A record is kept first, then it is applied and read back; turning Performance off restores their previous priority. It only reduces CPU competition; it frees no RAM and an FPS gain is not guaranteed. Off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.gpu_route: Run games on the discrete GPU
strings.plan.gpu_route.desc: On this laptop, the Windows graphics preference of the games detected here is set to High performance so they start on the discrete graphics card. Battery drains faster while playing; no FPS gain is promised. A record is kept first, then it is applied and read back; Off restores the previous preference. No administrator permission needed.
strings.perf.admin_skipped: Administrator permission was not given, so the groups that need it were not applied; the other changes are active.
strings.perf.legacy_unmigrated: The previous version's records contain settings that were not undone, and they could not be carried over to this version. strings.games.nv.detail.svc: Only this game's driver profile changes: power mode maximum performance, pre-rendered frames 1. Game files are not touched. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt; undo writes the previous value. No FPS gain is promised.
strings.games.nv.notice_applied: The NVIDIA game profile was set and read back.
strings.games.nv.notice_restored: The NVIDIA game profile returned to its previous value.
strings.games.nv.notice_denied: Administrator approval was not given; nothing changed.
strings.games.nv.notice_failed: The NVIDIA game profile could not be completed; check the history.
strings.games.nv.read_failed: driver profile could not be read
strings.games.nv.notice_partial: The operation stopped halfway: only some settings changed. With games closed, use Undo on the row to finish.
strings.games.upscaler.deferred: Game folders and driver profiles are not scanned while a game runs; this updates after it closes.
strings.games.nv.conflict: value changed after this app set it
strings.games.nv.keep_question: Keep the current driver value for {game}?
strings.games.nv.keep_detail: This setting was changed by another source after this app set it. Yes: the value stays as it is and only this app's record is closed. Administrator approval (UAC) is required.
strings.games.nv.keep_detail.svc: This setting was changed by another source after this app set it. Yes: the value stays as it is and only this app's record is closed. Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt.
strings.games.nv.notice_review: The setting changed after this app set it, or the undo could not be verified; retrying won't help. Use the row's option or check Activity.
strings.games.notice.admin_busy: Another administrator operation is in progress; try again when it finishes.
strings.diag.abstain_memory_channel_not_measured: One memory module was detected; no limit verdict was given because channel use was not measured.
strings.chk.incident.none: No crash, hardware error or display driver reset was logged in the last {days} days.
strings.chk.incident.access_denied: The Windows event log could not be read (access denied). This does not mean there were no crashes.
strings.chk.incident.read_error: Reading the Windows event log failed; crash status could not be verified.
strings.chk.incident.partial: The event log could only be partly read; no recognized crash was found, but it can't be called clean.
strings.chk.incident.partial_note: The event log was partly read; counts may be incomplete.
strings.chk.incident.clock: The system clock changed during this period; events were not linked together.
strings.chk.incident.shutdown: {count} unexpected shutdowns were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). The log alone doesn't show the cause; it may be a power cut, a freeze or an unstable setting. Next: run the App Test while watching temperatures.
strings.chk.incident.bugcheck: {count} blue screens were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}, stop code {code}). The exact cause can't be determined from the log. Next: check drivers, and run a stability test if the code repeats.
strings.chk.incident.bugcheck_nocode: {count} blue screens were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). The stop code could not be read.
strings.chk.incident.whea_fatal: {count} fatal hardware errors (WHEA) were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). This can point to hardware or unstable speed/voltage settings, but doesn't identify a failed part. Next: return BIOS overclocking to defaults and observe again.
strings.chk.incident.whea_corrected: {count} corrected hardware errors (WHEA) were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). The system corrected them; watch for a rising count.
strings.chk.incident.display_reset: {count} display driver resets were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). Next: check the GPU driver and run the App Test while watching temperatures.
strings.chk.incident.disk: {count} disk errors were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). Back up important data before running heavy disk tests.
strings.chk.summary_coverage: {total} checks: {good} verified · {action} need action · {unknown} not measurable · rules v{rules}
strings.chk.storage.nvme_ok: {disk}: no warnings in the NVMe health log (used {used}%, spare {spare}%, temperature {temp} °C). This doesn't prove the disk is sound; keep backups of important data.
strings.chk.storage.nvme_warning: {disk}: the NVMe health log reports a critical warning (spare {spare}%). Back up important data now; write tests won't run.
strings.chk.storage.nvme_media: {disk}: the NVMe log has {errors} media or data integrity errors. Back up important data; write tests won't run.
strings.chk.storage.nvme_worn: {disk}: {used}% of the rated write endurance is used. This isn't a failure record; keep your backups current.
strings.chk.storage.nvme_unread: {disk}: the NVMe health log could not be read; disk health is unverified.
strings.chk.storage.health_unsupported: {disk}: detailed disk health can't be read over this connection (USB, RAID or virtual).
strings.bench.storage_write_blocked: The disk reported a data risk; the disk test did not run.
strings.chk.rp.offer: You can optionally create a Windows system restore point before a major change.
strings.chk.rp_question: Create a Windows system restore point?
strings.chk.rp_detail: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. System Protection is not turned on, and old points aren't deleted. This doesn't replace the app's own setting records; Windows may skip creating a new point for a while.
strings.chk.rp_detail.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service creates it, no UAC prompt. System Protection is not turned on, and old points aren't deleted. This doesn't replace the app's own setting records; Windows may skip creating a new point for a while.
strings.chk.notice.rp_created: The restore point was created and verified in the list.
strings.chk.notice.rp_skipped: Windows did not create a new point (one may exist from a short while ago). Nothing changed.
strings.chk.notice.rp_protection_off: No point could be created because System Protection is off. The app won't turn it on; you can do so in System Properties.
strings.chk.notice.rp_disk_full: No point could be created because disk space is low.
strings.chk.notice.rp_denied: Administrator approval wasn't given; no point was created.
strings.chk.notice.rp_unverified: Windows finished, but the point could not be verified in the list. It was not counted as created.
strings.chk.notice.rp_failed: The restore point could not be created.
strings.chk.incident.shutdown_button: {count} unexpected shutdowns were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). The logs show the power button was held, so the system may have frozen. Next: run the App Test while watching temperatures.
strings.chk.incident.shutdown_sleep: {count} unexpected shutdowns were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}). The logs show the system was entering or leaving sleep. Next: check driver and BIOS sleep settings.
strings.chk.incident.bugcheck_whea: {count} blue screens were logged in the last {days} days (last: {date}), around the same time as a hardware error (WHEA). This can point to hardware or unstable speed/voltage settings rather than drivers, but doesn't identify a failed part. Next: return BIOS overclocking to defaults and observe again.
strings.chk.incident.whea_payload: The data in some hardware error records is corrupt; their details aren't reliable.
strings.chk.storage.health_unknown: {disk}: disk health could not be verified over this connection (USB, RAID or unknown).
strings.measure.endurance.stop.device_lost: The test stopped: the graphics device was lost or the scene could not run.
strings.measure.endurance.stop.hardware_error: The test was stopped: a new fatal hardware error (WHEA) was logged during the run.
strings.measure.endurance.stop.sensor_lost: The test was stopped: the GPU sensor became unreadable during the run.
strings.measure.endurance.cause_power: Cause: the power limit flag was observed. This doesn't mean the power supply has failed.
strings.measure.endurance.load_changed: The GPU clock dropped but the load was not equivalent in both windows, so it was not counted as heat evidence.
strings.comparison.game_build_mismatch: The game version differs or is unknown; no difference was calculated.
strings.comparison.hardware_mismatch: The hardware differs; no difference was calculated.
strings.history.cohort.result: Repeated runs (Off {a}, On {b}): average difference {delta} FPS, 95% range {low} to {high}.
strings.history.cohort.uncertain: The range includes zero: this can't be called an improvement.
strings.history.cohort.need_runs: This is only the observed difference; showing an effect needs at least 3 runs each for On and Off under the same conditions.
strings.history.overlay.legend: FPS on the same axis: hollow squares older run · filled squares newer run
strings.chk.latency.guide: The driver queue only affects DirectX 9/11 games; in DirectX 12 and Vulkan, latency depends on the game's own setting (such as Reflex). Those are set in the game. The app doesn't measure end-to-end latency, so it never says how many ms were saved.
strings.chk.latency.mouse_polling: Mouse report rate not measured. When you press Measure you move the mouse for 5 seconds; no setting is changed.
strings.chk.latency.mouse_polling.measuring: Move the mouse in circles for 5 seconds
strings.chk.latency.mouse_polling.result_min: Measured: at least ~{hz} Hz (median interval {ms} ms). At high rates Windows merges reports; the real value may be higher.
strings.chk.latency.mouse_polling.insufficient: Not enough data: the mouse did not move enough
strings.chk.network.dns_bench: DNS response times haven't been measured. 'Compare DNS' times name lookups through your current DNS and the Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard presets; no setting changes. DNS speed only affects name lookup, not in-game ping.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.done: DNS comparison finished ({n} queries per resolver). DNS speed only affects name lookup; it does not change in-game ping.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.row_modem_na: Current (router): not enough data (too few replies)
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.row_current_na: Current ({name}): not enough data (too few replies)
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.better: {name} is clearly faster than your current DNS: the median is {gain} ms ({pct}%) shorter. Only name lookup gets faster; your in-game ping doesn't change. 'Fix' opens the dialog with this preset preselected; the Yes/No is yours.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.same: The difference is not meaningful: changing DNS would not give a worthwhile gain. DNS speed only affects name lookup, not in-game ping.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.insufficient: Not enough data: most DNS queries went unanswered, so no comparison could be made.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.no_baseline: Your current DNS could not be measured or answered too rarely; there is no baseline, so changing DNS isn't suggested.
strings.chk.network.dns_bench.adguard_note: AdGuard blocks ad and tracker domains; some sites and apps may therefore load incompletely.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test: Health test not run. 'Health test' keeps the CPU under full load for 60 s, then runs a memory pattern test (about 2 min). No setting changes; no score is given. GPU load is not applied in this test.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.running: Health test running: {step}/2 {what} ({sec}/{total} s). It stops if a game opens.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.refused_battery: The health test does not start while battery saver is on; turn battery saver off and try again.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.cpu_stable: CPU stayed stable under 60 s of load: frequency median {first}% in the first 10 s, {last}% in the last 20 s (of rated frequency).
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.cpu_throttled: CPU slowed under load: frequency median {first}% in the first 10 s, {last}% in the last 20 s (of rated frequency), or the system applied a speed limit. Cooling, power plan or a firmware limit may be the cause; this measurement does not prove which.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.cpu_insufficien: Not enough data for the CPU result: too few valid frequency samples.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.no_sensor: Temperature sensor could not be read; no temperature is shown.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.ram_ok: Memory pattern test passed clean: {mib} MiB, 0 errors. Only part of total memory was tested.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.ram_errors: Memory pattern test found {errors} errors ({mib} MiB tested). One run is not a definite fault verdict; turn XMP/EXPO off and repeat.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.ram_partial: Memory test stayed partial because time ran out: {mib} MiB, {errors} errors. Not all patterns completed.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.ram_not_run: Memory test could not run: not enough free memory (at least 2 GiB must stay free).
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.gpu_stable: The GPU stayed stable under load.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.gpu_faulted: A GPU reset / device-removed event was seen during the test.
strings.chk.hardware.health_test.gpu_unavailable: GPU load was not applied in this test. Use the App Test for the GPU.
strings.guide.cs2.reflex_effect: appears off; turning it on can reduce the GPU queue.
strings.guide.cs2.vsync_effect: appears on; it can add latency to the frame queue.
strings.guide.driver_queue_effect: it can help on this game's DirectX 9/11 path; it's set separately with the NVIDIA profile on the Games row.
strings.gate.library.provider_source: A game library record could not be read
strings.measure.endurance.load_unknown: The GPU clock dropped but the load could not be read, so no cause was given.
strings.measure.endurance.flag_seen_output_held: A GPU limit flag was seen but output did not clearly drop, so it was not counted as the cause.
strings.chk.network.dns_auto: {adapter}: DNS is automatic (from the router). You can choose the Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or AdGuard preset (IPv4 and IPv6); undo returns to automatic.
strings.chk.network.dns_unknown: The DNS setting could not be read.
strings.chk.network.dns_policy: This PC uses a VPN, a work network or a DNS policy, so changing DNS isn't suggested.
strings.chk.network.dns_policy_unknown: DNS policies couldn't be verified, so changing DNS isn't suggested.
strings.chk.fix_detail_dns: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. Only this connection's IPv4 and IPv6 DNS switch to the preset you choose. The previous setting is saved; undo returns automatic (DHCP) to automatic. No latency or speed gain is promised; DNS only affects name lookup. AdGuard blocks ad and tracker domains. Turning Performance off doesn't undo this.
strings.chk.fix_detail_dns.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt. Only this connection's IPv4 and IPv6 DNS switch to the preset you choose. The previous setting is saved; undo returns automatic (DHCP) to automatic. No latency or speed gain is promised; DNS only affects name lookup. AdGuard blocks ad and tracker domains. Turning Performance off doesn't undo this.
strings.chk.network.load_blocked: The latency-under-load (bufferbloat) test is off in this version: the app has no test server of its own and doesn't load third-party servers without permission. The connection test only measures idle latency.
strings.bench.run.interrupted: The test was interrupted (the app or PC shut down); there's no result, and it wasn't restarted automatically.
strings.bench.reason.memory_address_pattern_mism: Memory check failed: the address-dependent pattern didn't read back correctly. This can signal instability; it isn't a definite fault verdict.
strings.chk.maint.offer: You can check the health of the Windows system image (DISM). If there's a problem, repair is asked separately.
strings.chk.maint_check_detail: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. It only reads; no file changes. It can take a few minutes.
strings.chk.maint_check_detail.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service runs it, no UAC prompt. It only reads; no file changes. It can take a few minutes.
strings.chk.maint_repair_detail: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. A restore point is created first; if that fails, repair doesn't start. Repair only uses the local source on this PC and doesn't download from Windows Update. This is maintenance, not a setting, so it can't be fully undone. It can take a long time and can't be cancelled. Success is reported only if a full scan says healthy.
strings.chk.maint_repair_detail.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service runs it, no UAC prompt. A restore point is created first; if that fails, repair doesn't start. Repair only uses the local source on this PC and doesn't download from Windows Update. This is maintenance, not a setting, so it can't be fully undone. It can take a long time and can't be cancelled. Success is reported only if a full scan says healthy.
strings.chk.notice.maint_denied: Administrator approval wasn't given; nothing ran.
strings.chk.notice.maint_failed: The Windows image operation could not complete.
strings.chk.notice.maint_healthy: The Windows quick check found no flagged damage; no repair is needed.
strings.chk.notice.maint_repairable: Repairable damage was found in the Windows system image.
strings.chk.notice.maint_non_repairable: The Windows system image can't be repaired; the app won't call it fixed. A Windows reset or reinstall may be needed.
strings.chk.notice.maint_repaired: Repair finished and a full scan reported healthy.
strings.chk.notice.maint_not_verified: Repair finished, but the full scan didn't report healthy; it wasn't counted as a success.
strings.chk.notice.maint_source_missing: No repair source was found on this PC. Downloading from Windows Update needs separate approval and isn't done in this version.
strings.chk.notice.maint_reboot_required: The repair needs a restart; success must be confirmed by checking again after restarting.
strings.chk.notice.maint_pending_reboot: A Windows restart is pending or its status couldn't be read; restart first.
strings.chk.notice.maint_unsupported: The image servicing interface isn't available on this Windows.
strings.chk.network.dns_unsupported: This Windows version doesn't provide the per-connection DNS interface, so changing DNS isn't suggested.
strings.chk.undo_detail_dns: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. The previous DNS setting is restored immediately; if it was automatic (DHCP), it returns to automatic. No restart is needed.
strings.chk.undo_detail_dns.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service applies it, no UAC prompt. The previous DNS setting is restored immediately; if it was automatic (DHCP), it returns to automatic. No restart is needed.
strings.chk.notice.maint_prev_interrupted: An earlier repair was interrupted. The image was read again; run the check again for the result.
strings.chk.notice.maint_no_restore_point: Repair didn't start because a restore point couldn't be created (System Protection may be off).
strings.chk.platform.tpm_unknown: TPM status could not be read.
strings.chk.platform.sb_off: Secure Boot is off. Some games' protection systems may require it.
strings.chk.platform.sb_unknown: Secure Boot status could not be read.
strings.chk.platform.bl_on: BitLocker is on. Before any BIOS change, make sure your recovery key is somewhere safe (the app doesn't read the key).
strings.chk.platform.bl_unknown: BitLocker status isn't read by this version; the app never reads the recovery key.
strings.chk.platform.cstate_unknown: The CPU C-State (BIOS) setting can't be read from Windows, so it isn't reported as on or off. Windows power settings are a separate control.
strings.chk.platform.firmware_gate: Because a security component couldn't be verified, BIOS/firmware changes aren't suggested; check the board maker's official documentation.
strings.chk.display.mpo_default: Display driver resets were logged. Multiplane overlay (MPO) is at the Windows default. Turning MPO off is disabled in the app until the vendor's official recipe is independently verified.
strings.chk.display.mpo_off: Display driver resets were logged. A value meant to turn MPO off is set on this PC (outside the app); its actual effect on this Windows version isn't verified.
strings.chk.display.mpo_unknown: Display driver resets were logged; the multiplane overlay (MPO) status could not be read.
strings.chk.display.mpo_other: Display driver resets were logged. A non-default multiplane overlay (MPO) value is set; its effect is unknown.
strings.bench.reason.capture_game_exited: the game closed before the measurement finished; the run is not complete
strings.bench.run.game_exited: The game closed during the measurement; the run is not valid.
strings.comparison.live_panel_mismatch: One run had the live panel on; no difference was calculated.
strings.diag.gate.label_or_group_missing: Diagnosis release gate closed: real samples lack a machine/run group or a verified label method (controlled experiment/expert review).
strings.diag.gate.machine_coverage: Diagnosis release gate closed: validation data does not come from enough distinct machines (at least 3).
strings.diag.gate.class_imbalance: Diagnosis release gate closed: limiting and healthy samples are not balanced in the validation data (at least 10 of each).
strings.diag.gate.device_family_uncovered: This device family (CPU, graphics card, form factor, storage) is not covered by validation data; no CPU/GPU verdict is given.
strings.diag.gate.split_leakage: Diagnosis release gate closed: leakage or a duplicated machine was found in the validation data.
strings.games.sources_pending: Sources have not been scanned yet.
strings.games.sources_note: Sources are only read; launcher files and game folders are never written. You can add a game from an unsupported source by its EXE file.
strings.games.source.disabled: off (format not verified on a device)
strings.games.add_exe.title: Choose the game's EXE file
strings.games.add_exe.question: Add {game} to the game list?
strings.games.add_exe.detail: Only the path is saved in this app's preferences; the game file and launcher are not touched. Setting changes stay blocked while this game runs. You can remove it from the list at any time.
strings.games.manual.remove_detail: Game files are not touched; only this list entry is removed.
strings.games.manual.err.invalid_path: This path cannot be added: it must be a full file path on a local drive.
strings.games.manual.err.not_exe: The selected file is not an executable EXE.
strings.games.manual.err.system_dir: Files in Windows, a drive root or a shared system folder cannot be added as games.
strings.games.manual.err.duplicate: This EXE is already in the list.
strings.games.manual.err.limit: At most 32 games can be added manually.
strings.games.manual.err.missing: The selected file was not found or could not be read.
strings.games.manual.err.dialog: The file picker could not be opened.
strings.games.manual.err.running: A running game cannot be removed from the list.
strings.chk.network.dns_preset: {adapter}: DNS uses the {preset} preset (IPv4 and IPv6).
strings.bench.reason.storage_verify_mismatch: Storage check mismatch: data written to the test file read back differently. Back up important files; this isn't a definite fault verdict.
strings.bench.reason.storage_verify_io_error: A read/write error occurred during the storage check; the disk result was not scored.
strings.bench.reason.storage_verify_incomplete: The storage check didn't finish within the time limit; the data can't be called verified.
strings.bench.reason.storage_verify_invalid: The storage check settings are invalid; no check was done.
strings.bench.reason.storage_verify_setup_failed: Memory for the storage check couldn't be allocated; the disk test was stopped.
strings.bench.reason.verify_size_invalid: verify size is invalid (must be a MiB multiple and not exceed the test file)
strings.plan.field.nv_power: Power management → Prefer maximum performance (global profile)
strings.plan.field.nv_queue: Prepared-frame queue → 1 (global profile; only affects DirectX 9/11 games)
strings.plan.field.nv_shader: Shader cache → at least 10 GB (global profile)
strings.guide.driver_queue_game_managed: the last In-Game Test saw DirectX 12/Vulkan from loaded modules; the driver frame queue may have no effect here, and the in-game setting (such as Reflex) decides latency.
strings.games.nv.detail_game_managed: The last In-Game Test saw DirectX 12/Vulkan in this game: the prepared-frame setting may have no effect here; an in-game latency setting (such as Reflex), if present, decides. The power mode setting still applies.
strings.games.manual.missing: Manually added EXE not found (it may have been moved or uninstalled)
strings.games.manual.err.save: The change could not be saved; the list was not changed.
strings.bench.reason.gpu_compute_mismatch: GPU compute check mismatched: the same calculation on the graphics card differed from the CPU result (calculation inconsistency). The scene was not scored; this is not a definitive fault verdict (driver, clock settings or heat can also cause it).
strings.bench.reason.gpu_verify_readback: The GPU compute check result could not be read back; the scene was not scored.
strings.bench.reason.gpu_verify_invalid: The GPU compute check configuration is invalid; no check was run.
strings.bench.reason.gpu_verify_incomplete: The GPU compute check did not finish within its time limit; the calculation cannot be called verified.
strings.bench.reason.gpu_verify_unsupported: The GPU compute check could not run on this device (no hardware graphics card or DirectX 11 compute).
strings.bench.reason.gpu_verify_setup_failed: Resources for the GPU compute check could not be allocated; no check was run.
strings.bench.verify.note.cpu_unsupported: {blocks} blocks compared (scalar + {isas}), {bad} blocks mismatched. Not supported on this processor: {unsupported}.
strings.bench.verify.note.storage: {blocks} blocks (1 MiB) written and read back, {bad} blocks mismatched.
strings.bench.reason.cpu_compute_mismatch: Processor calculation check mismatched: the same calculation gave a different result (calculation mismatch). The processor was not scored; this is not a definite hardware fault (overclock/voltage settings, heat or other causes are possible).
strings.bench.reason.cpu_verify_incomplete: The processor calculation check did not finish within the time limit; the calculation cannot be called verified.
strings.bench.reason.cpu_verify_invalid: The processor calculation check settings are invalid; no check was done.
strings.measure.mixed_load_warning: With a disk selected, the test also includes a part that loads the processor, graphics card and disk together. Save any open work before you start.
strings.bench.endurance.insufficient_windows: not enough measurement windows to compare
strings.bench.endurance.frequency_dropped: GPU clock dropped during the test
strings.settings.strip_desc: Stops by itself in games, tests and on battery
strings.settings.cleanup_hint: Cleanup suggestion after a game closes
strings.settings.cleanup_hint_desc: After a game closes, temporary files are only scanned and you get a notification if they take enough space. Nothing is deleted by itself; you say Yes on the Cleanup page to delete.
strings.tray.cleanup_hint: Game closed. Cleanable temporary files: {size}. To delete them, say Yes on System tools > Cleanup; nothing is deleted by itself.
strings.overview.readiness_pending: No results yet; the scan runs on the Game readiness page.
strings.history.filter.empty: No operations recorded for this filter.
strings.speed.title: Internet speed
strings.speed.question: Run an internet speed test?
strings.speed.detail: Connects to speed.cloudflare.com; at most ~256 MB of data and 60 s. The result is shown only in this session; it is not saved or sent.
strings.speed.bloat.line: Latency under load: {d} while downloading, {u} while uploading
strings.speed.bloat.note: This is the connection's latency under load, not a game server ping, and it does not promise in-game latency or FPS. Thresholds: an increase under 30 ms is low, under 100 ms is medium, above that is high.
strings.speed.note: Runs only when you start it, never while a game is running.
strings.speed.blocked_game: No speed test while a game is running.
strings.speed.fail.timeout: Not measured: the server did not respond
strings.speed.fail.tls: Not measured: a secure connection could not be made
strings.speed.server.none: Game server ping: no address set.
strings.speed.server.saved: Game server {ip}: not measured yet this session.
strings.speed.server.insufficient: Game server {ip}: not enough replies ({recv}/{sent}); not enough data. The server may block ping replies.
strings.speed.server.failed: Game server {ip}: the measurement could not start.
strings.speed.server.note: This is the ping (ICMP) latency to the address you typed. It can differ from the ping a game shows and does not promise in-game latency. The address is stored only on this PC.
strings.server_ping.title: Measure game server ping?
strings.server_ping.body1: About 20 small ping (ICMP) packets are sent to the address you type over roughly 4 seconds. Nothing else is sent; the address is stored only on this PC.
strings.server_ping.body2: Type a numeric IPv4 address, not a domain name. Not measured while a game is running.
strings.server_ping.label: Server IPv4 address
strings.update.failed: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection; the app will try again next time it starts.
strings.update.verify_failed: The update information could not be verified; nothing was downloaded.
strings.update.gate_body: This version is no longer supported. You need to update to continue.
strings.update.not_writable: This folder is not writable. Get the new version from the download page and replace the old one.
strings.update.rolled_back: The update could not be installed; the previous version was kept.

strings.proof.confirm.body1: During the measurement the experiment switches Performance between On and Off {n} times and measures the fixed test scene each time. It takes about {m} min; do not use the PC meanwhile.
strings.proof.confirm.body2: The settings changed are the ones selected on the Performance page. At the end (even if you cancel) Performance returns to its first state, Off, by restoring the previous values the app recorded.
strings.proof.stage.prepare: Performance effect experiment is running (details in the card below)
strings.proof.result.better: In this experiment Performance On raised the average FPS: the difference is above 0 at 95% confidence.
strings.proof.result.worse: In this experiment Performance On lowered the average FPS: the difference is below 0 at 95% confidence.
strings.proof.result.none: No difference: no meaningful FPS difference between Performance On and Off could be measured.
strings.proof.result.mixed: Mixed result: average FPS and 1% low FPS moved in opposite directions.
strings.proof.result.insufficient: Not enough data: at least 5 valid runs are needed in each arm.
strings.proof.result.conditions: Not comparable: conditions changed between runs ({fields}).
strings.proof.result.invalid: No result: run {n} was invalid ({why}). Performance was returned to Off.
strings.proof.result.aborted: The experiment did not finish; no result. Performance was returned to its first state (Off).
strings.proof.result.restore_failed: Returning Performance to Off could not be verified; no result. Check the Performance page.
strings.proof.note.scope: Only this experiment's measurement: this PC, this driver, the fixed scene. Not a game FPS prediction; it does not say which setting caused it.
strings.proof.note.quality: The difference may come from visual quality settings that Performance changed.
strings.proof.note.low1: Note: a significant difference was seen in 1% low FPS; the verdict is based on average FPS.
strings.proof.refuse.game_running: The experiment is not run while a game is running.
strings.proof.refuse.other_test_busy: The experiment does not start while another test or data deletion is running.
strings.proof.refuse.perf_not_off: The experiment starts with Performance Off.
strings.proof.refuse.plan_not_ready: The Performance plan is not ready yet; try again in a few seconds.
strings.proof.refuse.plan_empty: Performance has no setting to change; the experiment would be meaningless.
strings.proof.refuse.plan_needs_admin: All selected settings need administrator permission (UAC) and the helper service is not running; the experiment cannot run.
strings.proof.refuse.plan_needs_reboot: No measurable setting: the rest need a restart.
strings.proof.scope.measured: Measured: {n} setting group(s) that need no administrator rights. Settings that need administrator rights or a restart were not measured.
strings.proof.note.subset: This result only applies to the subset above; the effect of settings that need administrator rights was not measured.
strings.proof.confirm.scope: Only the {g} setting group(s) that need no administrator rights will be tried; administrator settings are not touched and UAC does not open.
strings.proof.confirm.scope_admin: {g} setting group(s) will be tried, including administrator settings. UAC does not open because the helper service is running. If the service drops during the experiment, the experiment stops without opening UAC and a restore is attempted.
strings.proof.scope.admin: Measured: {n} setting group(s), including administrator settings. Settings that need a restart were not measured.
strings.proof.note.subset_admin: This result only applies to the groups measured; the effect of settings that need a restart was not measured.
strings.proof.refuse.no_hardware_adapter: No hardware graphics adapter was found; the experiment is not supported on this PC.
strings.proof.note.none_scope: The no-difference result applies only to the measured settings on this PC; it says nothing about games.
strings.balance.report.hint: The report has no personal data and is sent nowhere; you share the file yourself.
strings.balance.report.failed: The report could not be saved.

Turning Performance on can set the game to High performance (shown in the plan); you can also do it in Settings > Display > Graphics.

strings.perf.tips.title: In-game tips
strings.perf.tips.1: If the game offers it, turn on NVIDIA Reflex or AMD Anti-Lag; it can reduce latency.
strings.perf.tips.2: Keep V-Sync off; with G-SYNC or FreeSync, cap FPS a few frames below the refresh rate.
strings.perf.tips.3: Compare before and after in the same scene with In-game Test.
strings.perf.tips.4: If the result is worse, press Off; the values the app changed are restored.
strings.guide.valorant.reflex_effect: On an NVIDIA GPU, turning it on can reduce latency if the game offers it; compare the effect on your own system.
strings.guide.valorant.vsync_effect: keeping it off avoids queueing delay; if you see tearing, use an FPS cap or variable refresh.
strings.guide.lol.vsync_effect: keeping it off avoids queueing delay; if you see tearing, use an FPS cap.
strings.guide.lol.fps_cap_effect: setting it a few frames below the refresh rate or at a sensible value can keep frame times even; compare the result in the same scene.
strings.bios.guide.title: Enabling the memory profile (BIOS/UEFI)
strings.bios.guide.readonly: Ecu Fps writes nothing to the BIOS or firmware; you carry out these steps yourself.
strings.bios.guide.enter.del_f2: Del or F2 key at startup
strings.bios.guide.enter.oem: F2, F10, Esc or Del depending on the maker
strings.bios.guide.enter.generic: usually Del or F2 at startup
strings.bios.guide.step.note: First note down or photograph the current memory values in the BIOS.
strings.bios.guide.step.enter: Restart the PC and enter the BIOS at startup.
strings.bios.guide.step.vendor_asus: The option is usually the profile switch in EZ Mode or the Ai Tweaker section in Advanced Mode.
strings.bios.guide.step.vendor_msi: The option is usually the profile switch in EZ Mode or in the OC section.
strings.bios.guide.step.vendor_gigabyte: The option is usually the Extreme Memory Profile line in the Tweaker section.
strings.bios.guide.step.vendor_asrock: The option is usually the memory profile line in the OC Tweaker section.
strings.bios.guide.step.profile: Enable only the memory profile ({profile}) and pick the first profile.
strings.bios.guide.step.only: Do not change any other setting, voltage or timing by hand.
strings.bios.guide.step.save: Save and exit (usually F10) and wait for the PC to start.
strings.bios.guide.step.fallback: If the PC does not boot, the board usually falls back to safe settings after a few tries; if not, follow the clear-CMOS step in the board manual.
strings.bios.guide.step.verify: Once Windows starts, rescan in Game Readiness; the app re-reads the configured memory speed and compares it with the rated speed.
strings.bios.guide.step.risk: Risk: a memory profile uses the rated settings but may count as outside the platform spec and rarely causes instability; if you see problems, return to defaults in the BIOS.
strings.bios.guide.step.oem_not_exposed: Prebuilt and laptop BIOS menus usually do not expose a memory profile option.
strings.bios.guide.step.oem_manual: If the option exists, see the manual on the maker's support page for your model; if not, the memory speed may not be changeable on this device.

strings.plan.feature.bluetooth: I don't use Bluetooth → turn off Bluetooth services
strings.plan.feature.bluetooth.desc: Say Yes if you don't use it. On a PC with no paired Bluetooth device, the Bluetooth services are set to Disabled and stopped if running. While applied, Bluetooth headsets, mice and controllers do not work. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous start type. No FPS gain is promised. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.feature.print: I don't use a printer → turn off printing services
strings.plan.feature.print.desc: Say Yes if you don't use it. On a PC with no real printer defined, the printing services are set to Disabled and stopped if running; nothing is touched while jobs are queued. While applied, printing and Print to PDF do not work. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous start type. No FPS gain is promised. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.feature.xbox: I don't use Xbox features → turn off Xbox services
strings.plan.feature.xbox.desc: Say Yes if you don't use them. On a PC with no Xbox/Game Pass game, Xbox controller or wireless adapter, Gaming Services or Game Bar capture, the Xbox sign-in, cloud save, Xbox network and input device services are set to Disabled. Gaming Services is not touched. While applied, Xbox app sign-in and cloud saves do not work. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous start type. No FPS gain is promised. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.feature.search: I don't use Windows Search indexing → turn off the indexer
strings.plan.feature.search.desc: Say Yes if you don't use it. The Windows Search indexer service is set to Disabled and stopped if running. While applied, Start and File Explorer searches run without an index and are slower; apps that rely on the index may return no results. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous start type. No FPS gain is promised. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.feature.store: Turn off automatic Store app updates
strings.plan.feature.store.desc: Say Yes if you don't use it. The Microsoft Store "update apps automatically" policy is written as off; the Store stays usable and you can update apps by hand. This policy may be ignored on some Windows editions (e.g. Home/Pro); its effect is not verified and not guaranteed. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous value. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.feature.svc.xblgamesave: Xbox Live Game Save service (XblGameSave) → disabled
strings.feature.svc.xblauthmanager: Xbox Live Auth Manager service (XblAuthManager) → disabled
strings.plan.defender: Exclude game folders from Defender scanning
strings.plan.defender.desc: Security trade-off: files in these folders are not scanned by Defender. Say Yes only for games you trust. Defender is not turned off; Off removes the exclusions. Exclusions you added yourself earlier are left alone. Not offered when Defender is not the active antivirus or exclusions are managed by organization policy. A record is kept first, then applied and read back. No speed gain is promised. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.game_priority.desc: Only these games: Counter-Strike 2 (when FACEIT is not installed), Dota 2, Minecraft. The game starts with Above Normal priority the next time it is launched; the game process is never touched. It only helps while the CPU is busy; no guarantee. Uses a Windows registry setting; security software may show an alert. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous state. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.debloat.edge.desc: Edge is not removed. Its startup boost and background mode are turned off by policy, so it stops running when you are not using it. Offered only when another browser is installed and is your default. If Edge already has a setting for these (for example from your organization), it is left alone. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous state. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.debloat.onedrive.desc: OneDrive is not removed, but file sync stops until you turn this Off: new and changed files are no longer uploaded or downloaded. Say Yes only if you do not use OneDrive. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous state. Needs administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.debloat.apps: Remove unused Microsoft media apps (for this user)
strings.plan.debloat.apps.desc: Removes the apps listed below for your account only; other users and Windows itself are not touched. Only apps that Windows keeps provisioned are offered, so Off installs them again from the copy on this PC (internet may be needed). No speed gain is promised. A record is kept first, then applied and read back. No administrator permission needed; off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.field.debloat_app: {name} → removed for this user (can be restored)
strings.plan.win11_cleanup.desc: Web (Bing) suggestions and recommended content in Start, and tips and suggestions on the lock screen are turned off for this user. This only simplifies the look; no FPS gain is expected. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous values. No administrator permission needed; off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.input.desc: 'Enhance pointer precision' (mouse acceleration) is turned off so cursor movement follows hand movement linearly. The effect is personal and disputed; no measured FPS gain exists. Windows applies the values at your next sign-in. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous values. No administrator permission needed; off until you turn it on.
strings.tweak.win11.lock_overlay: Tips and fun facts on lock screen → off
strings.plan.widgets.desc: The Windows 11 Widgets/News panel is turned off with a Microsoft policy, so the background panel stops. This is cleanup only: an FPS gain is not documented and not expected. If your organization already defines this policy, it is left alone. A record is kept first, then applied and read back; Off restores the previous state. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.undervolt.title: CPU undervolt eligibility
strings.undervolt.verdict.adjustable: May be adjustable with the vendor's tool
strings.undervolt.verdict.locked: Voltage adjustment is locked on this processor
strings.undervolt.verdict.not_supported: The vendor's tool does not support this processor family
strings.undervolt.verdict.unknown: Not enough data: support could not be verified
strings.undervolt.tool.xtu: Intel Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) or BIOS
strings.undervolt.tool.amd: AMD Ryzen Master or BIOS (Curve Optimizer)
strings.undervolt.step.no_auto: Ecu Fps does not write voltages or tune automatically; you make the change in the vendor's tool.
strings.undervolt.step.no_bypass: No attempt is made to bypass the lock or protection.
strings.undervolt.step.uvp: On 12th Gen and newer Intel processors Undervolt Protection (UVP) is on by default and Intel does not recommend turning it off. The option appears only if the board's BIOS offers it.
strings.undervolt.step.amd_check: Check Curve Optimizer support for your model on AMD's product page.
strings.undervolt.step.laptop_oem: On laptops the manufacturer (OEM) decides which options appear; if it is not in the menu it cannot be changed.
strings.undervolt.step.note: Write down the current values before changing anything.
strings.undervolt.step.small: Go in small steps; run the App Test and the In-Game Test after each step.
strings.undervolt.step.stability: A single test pass is not a stability guarantee. If you see a crash, a WHEA error or a performance drop, go back to the last working value.
strings.undervolt.step.warranty: Intel states that changing frequency or voltage may void the warranty and reduce stability.
strings.undervolt.step.amd_terms: Read Ryzen Master's own warnings and terms.
strings.undervolt.stability.failed: Errors seen: go back to the last working value
strings.undervolt.stability.no_failure: No errors in these tests (not a stability guarantee)
strings.diag.combined.not_supported: Heat/power limits under combined load cannot be tracked on this graphics card (no vendor interface)
strings.diag.combined.insufficient: Not enough data for the combined-load heat/power check
strings.diag.combined.no_limit: No verified heat/power limit seen under combined load
strings.diag.combined.combined_only: Heat/power limit seen only under combined load (not in the scene alone)
strings.diag.combined.also_solo: Heat/power limit also seen in the scene alone; not specific to combined load
strings.diag.combined.withheld: Combined-load diagnosis is not shown yet: its accuracy has not been proven on real hardware
strings.diag.combined.cpu_not_measured: Processor temperature and power were not measured
strings.hw.matrix.write_unit_only: A write path exists in code; unit/mock tests only. No real-device write proof; release gate closed.
strings.hw.matrix.write_gated_off: A write path exists in code but is switched off until the unit and meaning are confirmed in official documentation.
strings.hw.matrix.read_bios_guide: Read-only estimate and BIOS guide; no official write path from Windows.
strings.hw.matrix.read_game_config_only: The game config file is only read (currently CS2 only); writing game settings is closed.
strings.hw.matrix.read_telemetry_device_read: Driver telemetry is read; the read was confirmed on a real device on the dev PC (no writes).
strings.hw.matrix.amd_sdk_license_pending: AMD SDK licence (ADLX / Ryzen Master) not accepted by the product owner; no headers or binding.
strings.hw.matrix.igcl_no_binding_no_device: No Intel IGCL binding and no Intel GPU test device; contract and mock tests only.
strings.hw.matrix.other_vendor_feature: This setting is another vendor's driver feature; it has no counterpart for this vendor identity.
strings.hw.matrix.excluded_policy: Excluded by product policy; never enabled for any vendor.
strings.hw.matrix.policy_no_oc_voltage_fan_write: Product invariant: no generic voltage / fan / overclock writes; administrator rights do not enable it.
strings.hw.matrix.not_implemented: Not implemented yet; no code path.
strings.hw.matrix.os_no_documented_api: Windows offers no documented, dependable API for this operation.
strings.settings.net_note_speed: Internet speed test: runs only when you say Yes and no game is running; it connects to speed.cloudflare.com, uses at most 256 MB of data and takes at most 60 s. The upload step sends only blank (zero-filled) test bytes; no personal data is sent.
strings.settings.net_note_update: Update check: runs once when the app opens and whenever you press Check above. It only reads signed release info from github.com; your version, hardware and settings are not sent.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.hybrid_target_unknown: NVIDIA driver setting skipped (not enough data): this PC has more than one graphics adapter and the adapter the game runs on could not be verified. To avoid writing for the wrong adapter, this part is not applied.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.adapters_unread: NVIDIA driver setting skipped (not enough data): the graphics adapter list could not be read.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.vendor_unread: NVIDIA driver setting skipped (not enough data): the adapter vendor could not be read, so it could not be confirmed as NVIDIA.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.target_not_found: NVIDIA driver setting skipped (not enough data): the target adapter was not found in the adapter list.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.no_nvidia_adapter: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: this PC has no NVIDIA graphics adapter.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.no_hardware_gpu: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: no hardware graphics adapter was found (software/remote adapter only).
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.target_not_nvidia: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: the adapter the game runs on is not an NVIDIA adapter.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.target_not_hardware: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: the target adapter is a software or remote adapter.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.driver_runtime: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: the NVIDIA driver component (NVAPI) could not be loaded on this PC.
strings.plan.nvidia.gate.write_not_supported: NVIDIA driver setting not supported: the support table has no driver-write row for this setting.
strings.storage.rec_tip: At least {rec} GB free is advised for updates.
strings.storage.hdd_tip: Moving the games to an SSD noticeably shortens load times.
strings.chk.notice.fix_all_reboot: {n} settings fixed; restart the computer for them to take effect.
strings.chk.notice.fix_all_partial: {n} settings fixed, {m} could not be fixed. Details are in History.
strings.settings.advanced_desc: Start with Windows, animations, light strip, game consents and support bundle. Closed by default; no setting was removed.
strings.diag.help: Built from hardware information and measurements. Without evidence there is no verdict; this is not a fault test.
strings.diag.gate.closed_short: Diagnosis gate closed: no firm verdict is given.
strings.diag.scene.short: Measured in the Bottleneck test at {res}; this test scene only.
strings.plan.power_usb.desc: In the active power plan, idle USB devices are no longer suspended while plugged in; the battery value is not changed. Idle power use may rise slightly. No FPS promise. Off restores the previous value. Asks for administrator permission (UAC).
strings.plan.foreground_boost: Processor priority for the foreground program
strings.plan.foreground_boost.desc: The processor time-slice setting Windows gives the foreground program is changed. Its effect is disputed and has not been measured by this app; no difference in games is guaranteed. Off restores the previous value. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.svchost_split.desc: Windows services are grouped into fewer shared processes; a fault in one service can affect the others in the same process (less service isolation). Its effect is disputed. A restart is required. Off restores the previous value. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.boot_tick.desc: The dynamic timer tick is turned off in the boot configuration. Microsoft describes this option as a debugging option; its effect is disputed and idle power use may rise. A restart is required. Off restores the previous value. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.plan.nvidia_extra.desc: Additional settings in the NVIDIA driver's global profile are changed, only when the game runs on the NVIDIA card. Image quality or latency behaviour may change; no FPS promise. Off restores the previous values. Asks for administrator permission (UAC); off until you turn it on.
strings.vendor.ll.status.unsupported: Not supported: no usable driver API for this adapter.
strings.vendor.ll.status.insufficient: Not enough data: the driver is present but the feature state could not be read.
strings.vendor.ll.status.guide: Guide only: you apply the setting yourself; the app does not read or change it.
strings.vendor.ll.amd.driver: AMD Anti-Lag (driver level): enabled per game or globally in the AMD driver software.
strings.vendor.ll.amd.ingame: AMD Anti-Lag 2 (in-game SDK): appears in the game's own settings only if the game integrates it; it is not the same as driver-level Anti-Lag.
strings.vendor.ll.intel.driver: Intel low latency mode (driver level): found in the game settings of Intel Graphics Software.
strings.vendor.ll.intel.ingame: Intel XeLL (in-game SDK): appears in the game's own settings only if the game integrates it; it is separate from the driver-level low latency mode.
strings.vendor.ll.footnote: Menu names and locations can vary by version; not verified on this device.
strings.chk.interrupt.msi_on: {name}: MSI (message-signaled interrupts) is On. Read-only; the app does not change it.
strings.chk.interrupt.msi_on_prio: {name}: MSI (message-signaled interrupts) is On; interrupt priority value {priority}. Read-only; the app does not change it.
strings.chk.interrupt.msi_off: {name}: MSI (message-signaled interrupts) is Off. Read-only; the app does not change it.
strings.chk.interrupt.msi_off_prio: {name}: MSI (message-signaled interrupts) is Off; interrupt priority value {priority}. Read-only; the app does not change it.
strings.chk.interrupt.no_data: {name}: MSI state could not be read; not enough data.
strings.chk.interrupt.unsupported: {name}: This device reports no MSI setting (not supported).
strings.chk.memory.standby_pressure: Standby memory is {standby_gib} GiB and free memory is {free_gib} GiB of {total_gib} GiB total (measured).
strings.chk.standby_purge_detail: Administrator approval (UAC) is required. No data is deleted. Modern Windows manages standby memory itself; the benefit is unproven (disputed). This is a maintenance job and cannot be undone like a setting. Standby memory is measured before and after.
strings.chk.standby_purge_detail.svc: Administrator rights are needed; the helper service runs it, no UAC prompt. No data is deleted. Modern Windows manages standby memory itself; the benefit is unproven (disputed). This is a maintenance job and cannot be undone like a setting. Standby memory is measured before and after.
strings.chk.notice.standby_purged: Standby memory purged: {n} MiB before, {m} MiB after (measured).
strings.chk.notice.standby_unmeasured: Standby memory purged; size could not be measured.
strings.chk.notice.standby_failed: Standby memory could not be purged (Windows refused).
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.not_verified: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not supported): this option stays off until a full round is verified in an isolated test environment.
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.battery: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not supported): the boot setting is not changed on battery-powered devices.
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.power_unread: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not enough data): whether the device runs on a battery could not be read.
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.bitlocker_on: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not supported): BitLocker is on for the system drive; the boot setting is not changed.
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.bitlocker_unread: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not enough data): the BitLocker state of the system drive could not be read.
strings.plan.boot_tick.gate.bcd_unread: Dynamic timer tick skipped (not enough data): the current value in the boot configuration could not be read; it is not changed without a restorable record.

strings.plan.field.nv_fxaa: FXAA → Off (global profile; FXAA turned on in the driver is turned off)
strings.guide.fortnite.reflex_effect: On an NVIDIA GPU, keeping it on is designed to reduce latency; compare the effect on your own system.
strings.guide.fortnite.vsync_effect: keeping it off reduces input lag; if you see tearing, use a G-SYNC or FreeSync display.
strings.guide.fortnite.fps_cap_effect: with V-Sync off it can be left unlimited; if you see tearing, match it to the display refresh rate.
strings.guide.warzone.dynamic_resolution_effect: if your version offers it, you pick a target frame rate and the game adjusts resolution to match; compare the result in the same scene.
